verdict.rationale: The firm's own O-1 practice page documents O-3 dependent eligibility for an accompanying spouse and children under 21. That covers only one of the three named dependent categories, and the page does not say the firm prepares those dependent filings. Missing for 10: H-4 dependent coverage, dependent work authorization (e.g., H-4 EAD), explicit statement that dependent petitions are handled as part of the service, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service

citations.quote: An accompanying spouse and/or any children under the age of 21 may be eligible to apply for an O-3 visa.
